title: Mixing Past Tenses

vocab.ex: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
When she arrived, we had already left.
I had studied English before I moved to Canada.
After I finished the report, I went home.
She had already left when I called.
I had just sat down when the meeting started.
I've worked here since 2019.
I've lived here for five years.
I finished college three years ago.
Suddenly, the lights went out.
Meanwhile, the rest of the team was waiting.
At that time, I was still studying.
By the time I arrived, the meeting had ended.
Previously, she had worked at a bank.
Once I finished, I felt relieved.
He was still working when I left.
I hadn't finished yet when she called.
I had never seen snow before that trip.
Had you ever traveled alone before?
So far, I've learned a lot in this job.
I had called her earlier that day.
Later, I realized my mistake.
That day, everything changed.
One day, she decided to change careers.
In the end, everything worked out fine.
Eventually, we found a solution.
First, I checked my email.
Then, I went to the meeting.
Finally, we finished the project.
Afterwards, we celebrated.

expressions.meaning: Enquanto eu estava fazendo X, Y aconteceu
expressions.example: While I was driving, my phone rang.

expressions.expr: By the time I arrived, [Y] had already happened
expressions.meaning: Quando eu cheguei, Y já tinha acontecido
expressions.example: By the time I arrived, the meeting had already started.

expressions.meaning: Eu nunca tinha feito X antes
expressions.example: I'd never given a presentation before that day.

sentences: While I was working, the internet stopped.
By the time I got there, she had already left.
I had never visited Brazil before last year.
I have just finished my English homework.
Meanwhile, my colleague was preparing the slides.
First I checked my notes, then I called the client.
In the end, everything worked out well.

grammar.title: Misturando os quatro tempos do passado
rules: Past Simple: ação concluída em um momento específico — I finished the report.
Past Continuous: ação em andamento, geralmente interrompida — I was finishing the report when she called.
Present Perfect: liga o passado ao presente, sem tempo específico — I have finished the report.
Past Perfect: ação anterior a outra ação passada — I had finished the report before she called.

rows: ação anterior a outra no passado
I had called her before he arrived.
